 - The trust model in current AI applications is flawed, leading to significant security vulnerabilities.

Suica is Japan's first IC transit card, launched in 2001, which revolutionized public transportation in the Tokyo area by allowing fast and efficient travel without needing a centralized backend for each transaction. The technology behind Suica utilizes contactless integrated circuits, enabling transactions to occur in under 200 milliseconds by processing locally at the gate, thus accommodating the high passenger volume of Tokyo's rail system. Over time, Suica evolved from a transit card into a multifunctional payment method used at various businesses, showcasing significant advancements in cashless transactions in Japan.

 - Suica was launched in 2001 and enabled efficient, cashless transit across Tokyo's rail network.
 - The card uses advanced contactless integrated circuit technology to conduct fast transactions locally.

Source: https://www.tokyodev.com/articles/the-story-of-suica
